messages:
Susan (Auditor): Hi team — auditor here. We're scoping evidence for the SOC2 fieldwork. Need clarity on what you can provide for: RBAC change history, KMS key rotation proof, vuln-triage linkage to incidents, and how you bundle 'pre-change' vs 'post-change' snapshots. Also any signed manifests or hash proofs you can produce. Link I shared earlier: https://files.redwood.example.com/audits/req-2026-04

Sanjay (eng-security): Hey @Susan, noted. Quick q: for RBAC changes do you want only rolebinding diffs (k8s) or full IAM policy versions + PR history? And retention window — 90 days or 1 year?

Maria (sec-eng): Susan — set we can produce both. We typically include:
- rolebinding diffs (kubectl get rolebinding -o yaml + audit logs)
- IAM policy versions from AWS IAM change history
- PRs + commit SHAs that triggered the change (we'll include the ticket id)
For KMS: we can produce the key rotation timeline, CloudTrail entries showing GenerateDataKey/Decrypt, and a signed manifest (sha256 hashes) of the exported bundle. Example export command we use:```sh
./scripts/export-evidence --bundle-name=soc2-2026-04-<org> --include=kms,rbac,cloudtrail --sign --out=/tmp/bundle.tar.gz```
We normally keep forensic snapshots for 1 year by default but for audits we can extend to 3 years if needed. Which scope do you want?

Tyler (infra): +1 to Maria. Also to be clear: for service accounts do you want deprovisioning proofs (deprov timestamp + actor) or just active bindings? We can attach the PR + CI pipeline link that removed permissions.

Susan (Auditor): We want both pre-change snapshots (just prior to the change) and post-change attestations for a sample of changes. Deprovisioning proofs are required for service accounts that had elevated access within the audit window. 90 days is minimum, 1 year preferred. For acceptance, we need: manifest.json (signed), sha256 sums, and mapping file linking evidence file -> control ID.

Maria (sec-eng): Ok — plan: we will produce a sample bundle for the last 6 months that includes:
1) RBAC_diffs/<date>-role-diff.txt (kubectl diffs + audit event ref)
2) IAM_versions/<role>-versions.json (exported)
3) KMS_rotation/rotation-log.csv + signed-manifest.sha256
4) VULN_TRIAGE/ticket-links.csv (vuln id -> jira ticket -> incident id)
5) SERVICE_ACCOUNT/deprov-proofs.csv (actor, timestamp, evidence-link)
We will map each file to control IDs (CC6, CC7, etc.) and include a README that shows how to verify signatures. Will add the PR/commit SHAs.

Sanjay (eng-security): For the vuln triage linkage: we'll include a short timeline per vuln with fields: vuln_id, discovery_ts, triage_owner, fix_pr, deploy_ts, incident_link (if any). That should satisfy auditor crosswalk requests.

Susan (Auditor): Perfect. Two asks before you run: 1) can the manifest include envelope metadata for KMS (key id, rotation version, and key policy hash)? 2) please timestamp and UTC-normalize all entries.

Maria (sec-eng): Yes to both. We'll include envelope metadata and include a header: "envelope_key_id","rotation_version","policy_sha256" in the KMS CSV. All timestamps will be RFC3339 UTC.

Tyler (infra): I'll kick off the export run. Flagging the oncall job so we have an audit trail. cc @oncall-bot start job

oncall-bot: Export job queued: job_id=job-2026-04-18-717, started at 2026-04-18T15:17:10Z. Upload target: s3://redwood-audit-exports/soc2-2026-04/job-717. Progress updates will be posted here. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Susan (Auditor): Thanks all — please confirm when the sample bundle is uploaded and share a temp presigned link. I'll review manifest+sample and get back with any follow-ups within 48 hours. :thumbsup:

Maria (sec-eng): Will do. ETA for initial sample bundle: ~24 hours. I'll post the presigned URL here when ready.
